## Personality

Harmon Andrews is a character who advocates for strict discipline. He notably advised that the strap ought to be used more frequently.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)_

## History

Harmon Andrews is a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) whose news and activities occasionally feature in the local gossip. During a severe and unusually devastating hailstorm that strikes the community, his roof suffers damage. He later hires an inexperienced farmhand who accidentally inflicts an injury on his horse, an incident that becomes a subject of neighborhood news.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. ## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon Andrews shares a family connection with [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md). He notably saved her from falling overboard by catching her by her sash during an outing.

- Saved — caught her by her sash when she nearly fell overboard  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
